{{Hatnote|Championship constructed pools are on [[Formats]].}}
'''Custom formats''' are constructed and limited environments published outside [[Decipher]] and the [[Players Committee]]. They are not a championship era. Championship [[GEMP]] tables load Decipher and Players Committee cards. Fan products stay in isolated formats.
